title: Refuse a native change status reply that names no change ID (issue 63, review thread on #71)
description: Refuse a native change status reply that names no change ID (issue 63, review thread on #71)
acceptance_criteria: With SpecSync configured chough checkpoint --native-change refuses as refused:native-change-unknown when the status reply is JSON that names neither summary.id nor change.id (for example [] or {}) and .chough/session.json stays byte-identical even with other updates in the same call; a reply that names the requested ID still saves; a reply naming another ID still refuses as refused:native-change-mismatch; docs/cli.md states it; the new test fails on the branch before the fix and fledge lanes run verify passes

answers.constraints: Bounded follow-up for issue 63 and Leif's P2 review thread on #71 only: no new dependency or schema or output-key change and no change to stage gates or to next/status native reads
